end.summary:
Practised keeping track of objects by making one mark for each object.
Made one mark for each object correctly in 2 of 3 attempts without help.
Discussed that each sheep or goat gets exactly one line, even if the object is larger.
Ended by explaining that three goats make three lines.
end.parentNote: Parth practised matching one mark to each object and gave the example of one line for every goat. They asked whether a larger object could get two marks; this was clarified later with the one-object, one-mark rule. At home, try counting small groups of household objects by drawing one mark for each item.
